title: Java Concurrency & Multithreading
intro: Java Concurrency and Multithreading interview questions are where senior interviews are won or lost. This page covers threads and the Thread lifecycle, the Java Memory Model (happens-before, volatile vs synchronized), synchronization and locks, the ExecutorService and thread pools, CompletableFuture, concurrent collections (ConcurrentHashMap internals), virtual threads (Java 21+ Project Loom), and the patterns interviewers actually ask about (producer-consumer, CountDownLatch vs CyclicBarrier vs Semaphore). Every answer leads with the conceptual model, then the API, then the failure mode that distinguishes a 3-year engineer from a 10-year one.
